data.headline: Boxing Day: knock out the holiday leftovers with Fiber Uppercut
data.image_alt: A tub of Fiber Uppercut next to holiday leftovers and a glass of water

data.heading: The holidays are over. Your gut comeback isn't
data.body:
The gifts are unwrapped, the leftovers are in the fridge, and your gut is ready for its own comeback. Fiber Uppercut is a once-a-day powder that mixes into water, smoothies or coffee in seconds. Citrus-peach flavor, no grit, no gluten.

Mix one scoop with 8 oz of liquid. Stir, sip, done. Grab it before the Boxing Day sale ends.

Try it for $10.
